I’m getting old now, so I don’t like making big changes. On these 3.1 mu, I’ll still do wheat and then maize after it, same as we’ve done for years. This land is small, and money is not plenty, so I watch every yuan. But I also know if I save too much on fertilizer, the crop will show it and the yield drops fast. For wheat, I’ll put a decent base fertilizer before sowing in early October, then see the苗情 in spring. If the leaves look pale around jointing, I’ll topdress again. Wheat needs water here, so I’ll probably irrigate about three times if the year is normal. After wheat harvest in June, I won’t waste time with heavy tillage because the window is too short. I’ll clear the field quick and plant summer maize right away. Maize grows fast in the rainy season, so I won’t irrigate unless the rain is short. I use what people around here use, mostly bought seed, simple herbicide, and only spray insects if I really see a problem. I’m not chasing the highest yield, just a steady harvest without spending too much cash.
